Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: The Planner accepted and propagated an incorrect claim from the English Wikipedia page that listed Daniel Poiré as Jean-Marie Poiré’s father, despite concurrent evidence indicating Alain Poiré is the father (e.g., the official site and French sources). This reliance on a single, conflicting source without resolving discrepancies or prioritizing more authoritative/consistent sources introduced the wrong lineage (confusing the grandfather Daniel with the father Alain) and set the task on a path toward an incorrect solution.
